transcript: My friend, here is one of the healthiest things you can give your body each morning. First, take half a lemon, a spoon of chia seeds and a touch of cinnamon. Three small things. Yet together, they awaken the entire system. Pour one cup of water. Add one heaping tablespoon of chia seeds. Let them expand, let them soften. Squeeze half a lemon or lime, allowing the living enzymes to fall into the water like morning sunlight. Then add half a teaspoon of cinnamon, the ancient spice that warms the blood and calms the body. Now, why is this little drink so powerful? Because, my friend, when you begin your day with life, your body answers with life. This mixture gently wakes up your metabolism. It supports healthy glucose and insulin levels. So your energy stays steady and your mind stays clear. It cleanses the liver, moves the lymphatic system, and brings harmony to the intestines. Helping the body release what it no longer needs and easing constipation and heaviness. It even helps lower bad cholesterol and triglycerides, protecting your heart, the center of your life force. Drink it 10 minutes before your first meal. You will feel fuller, calmer, more balanced. A small ritual with a great effect. Your body will thank you, my friend. It always responds to the kindness you give it.
